name: Coconut Crunchy Cookies
ingredients_raw: Refined Wheat Flour - Maida, Sugar, Refined Palm Oil, Invert Syrup, Coconut Powder (1.96%), Leavening Agents [INS 503(ii) & INS 500(ii)], Edible Starch, Iodised Salt, Emulsifiers [INS 322 & INS 471], Acidity Regulator [INS 450(i)] and Artificial Flavouring Substance (Coconut). Allergen Information: Contains Wheat and Soy. May Contains Milk, Sulphite and Nut.
